stories.title: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system with CRISPR-like repeats
stories.reason: Genuine AI-for-science result from Anthropic (not a product launch) — Claude autonomously found a real, previously-unrecognized enzyme system; substantive enough that not knowing it is a gap.
key_facts: Claude found 'array-associated reverse transcriptases' (ART) in bacteriophages: an RT enzyme + partner gene + CRISPR-array-like repeats
~950 Claude agents ran 21 hours, 210M tokens, screened 200k+ reverse transcriptases down to 3,500 candidates then 20 compelling ones
The RT itself was known, but Claude was first to notice the associated non-coding array + accessory protein — the defining CRISPR-like feature
MIT's Feng Zhang commented positively; function still unknown, released as a preprint, further wet-lab work ongoing
